Day one: a small, engaged team models
CSDM correctly in one room.

Year five: 40 teams who were never in that
room independently create and update CIs,
relationships, and service mappings.

The real test isn't 'modeled correctly once.'
It's 'stays correct as everyone else touches it.'
caption: Getting CSDM right at launch is the easy part.

Not: design the model once, hand it off.

Is: design the ongoing governance process -
- named stewards per service domain
- review before new CI classes/relationships
- recurring data-quality audits
- feedback loop back into the model itself
caption: The architect owns the governance process, not just the initial model.
